name: How long does a custom home renovation usually take?
description: Project duration depends on scope; smaller renovations may take weeks, while whole-home remodels can take several months.

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom home renovation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom home renovation varies significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. A smaller renovation, such as a single bathroom, might take 4-8 weeks, while a major whole-home remodel could span 6-12 months or even longer. Factors like design finalization, material lead times, permitting processes, and unforeseen structural issues can influence the timeline. A detailed project schedule will be provided after the design phase is complete, offering a more accurate estimate.
